item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:50 HKT 19/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Mitag will move across the vicinity of the northern part of the Pearl River Estuary and weaken gradually tomorrow. It will be windy at first over the region. There will be squally showers and thunderstorms. With Mitag weakening and departing, showers will ease off gradually early next week. The weather will improve briefly and will be very hot. Tropical Cyclone Ragasa will to move towards the vicinity of Luzon Strait and intensify significantly in the next couple of days, and enter the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. It will then edge closer to the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of its broad circulation, the weather over the region will deteriorate with winds strengthening significantly midweek next week. There will be heavy squally showers, thunderstorms and significant storm surge. Seas will be very rough with swells.

Date/Month: 20/09 (Saturday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
